fields.System.Title: OUT-401 — Assign a pick task to a picker
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want to be given the next piece of work, so that I always know what to
do without asking a supervisor.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given unassigned tasks, when I request work, then one task group is assigned to me
  • and locked to me.
  • - Given ten pickers requesting work simultaneously from a pool of ten tasks, then each
  • task goes to exactly one picker.
  • - Given assignment, then it uses a conditional update that affects exactly one row —
  • not a read followed by a write.
  • - Given I already have an incomplete assignment, then I am returned to it rather than
  • given new work.
  • - Given a task assigned to someone else, then I cannot confirm any of its lines.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | pick_task |
| Risks | Two pickers on one task ([doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency (mandatory) |
